info.title: Morfee
info.description: Morfee turns a saved HTML template plus JSON into a finished PDF document: a quote, an invoice, a work order, a certificate. Paste your HTML once, point at the fields that come from your data, and every call after that is one POST request. Get an API key at https://morfee.furo.solutions/keys.

ApiKeyAuth.description: A key from https://morfee.furo.solutions/keys. It belongs to one organization and reaches nothing outside it.
ApiKeyAuth.name: X-Api-Key

get.description: Every template in your library, with its id, name and how many fields it has. Start here: you need a template id to render a document. Paged; loop on nextOffset until it is null to see everything.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many templates to return, up to 500

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where to start, for paging past the first 'limit' templates

post.description: Renders one document from a saved template and your data. Use format=url so the answer is a small JSON object holding a download link, which is what a workflow tool wants: a link survives being passed between steps, raw PDF bytes do not.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: 'url' returns a JSON object with a download link, valid for an hour. 'pdf' returns the raw PDF bytes. 'html' returns the rendered HTML, to check before making paper.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own (a GUID will do). The same key sent again returns the first answer instead of rendering a second document, which is what makes a retry in a flow safe.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The template id and the data to fill it with

200.description: With format=url, a JSON object holding the download link. With format=pdf, the raw PDF bytes. With format=html, the rendered HTML.

get.description: What your plan allows and what you have used against it this month. Ask this before you need it: included is what you pay for and going over it costs money per document, while limit is where rendering stops. Amounts are in cents.

templateId.description: The id of a saved template, from List templates or from the builder's URL

data.description: The JSON your template's fields come from. Its shape is whatever the template expects: read it back with 'Read one template' first if you are not sure.

url.description: A download link for the PDF, valid for an hour and needing no key

bytes.description: The size of the document in bytes

fields.description: How many fields this template has bound

nextOffset.description: Where the next page starts, or null on the last page

planUntil.title: Plan until
planUntil.description: The day the agreement ends, if it has one
